title: Copilot Studio, Power Platform Support
description:
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly capable SharePoint Support Engineer to provide end\-to\-end operational support for SharePoint Online and SharePoint Server environments. The ideal candidate will have strong SharePoint administration experience, Power Automate workflow troubleshooting skills, basic Azure knowledge, and familiarity with compliance administration fundamentals. This role requires the ability to work in any global time zone, handle incidents and escalations, and communicate effectively with business users, stakeholders, and technical teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide L2/L3 support for SharePoint Online and SharePoint On\-Prem (SharePoint Server) environments.
* Administer SharePoint sites: site provisioning, permissions management, groups, libraries, lists, and governance alignment.
* Support SharePoint Server installation, configuration, and maintenance activities (Farm setup, service applications, IIS basics, patching support).
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot workflows using Power Automate (Flow) including triggers, actions, connectors, approvals, and error handling.
* Diagnose and resolve workflow failures, connector issues, authentication problems, and throttling/limits\-related failures.
* Provide basic compliance support: understanding retention, auditing, sensitivity labels, DLP basics, and compliance\-related troubleshooting.
* Work with Microsoft 365 admin centers and coordinate with Security/Compliance teams for governance and audit\-related requests.
* Support basic Azure\-related tasks such as understanding Azure AD/Entra ID concepts, app registrations, permissions, and identity troubleshooting.
* Perform user and access lifecycle support: external sharing support, guest access basics, and troubleshooting authentication/access issues.
* Provide incident management: ticket triage, root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and preventive measures.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, KB articles, and support handover notes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (Networking, Security, Identity, Endpoint, App teams) for end\-to\-end issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to operational SLAs, support processes, change management, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in 24x7 support model and on\-call/rotational shifts across any time zone.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
 SharePoint Administration (Mandatory)
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with SharePoint Online administration (site management, permissions, governance, sharing settings).
* Experience supporting SharePoint lists/libraries, views, metadata, content types, versioning, and site templates.
* Ability to troubleshoot common SharePoint end\-user and admin issues effectively.


 Power Automate / Workflow (Mandatory)
   

  

* Strong knowledge of Power Automate workflow creation and troubleshooting.
* Experience with connectors (SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, Forms, Approvals, Excel, etc.).
* Ability to debug flow run history, handle errors, optimize logic, and apply best practices.


 SharePoint Server (Mandatory / Strong Plus)
   

  

* Experience with SharePoint Server installation and configuration (2013/2016/2019/SE).
* Understanding of SharePoint farm architecture, IIS basics, SQL connectivity concepts, and service applications.
* Experience supporting patching/upgrade assistance and health checks (as per operational procedures).


 Azure / Identity (Basic Required)
   

  

* Basic knowledge of Azure / Entra ID fundamentals: users/groups, authentication concepts, and access policies basics.
* Exposure to Azure App Registration concepts and permissions (Graph/SharePoint access is a plus).


 Compliance (Basic Required)
   

  

* Basic understanding of M365 Compliance concepts: audit logs, retention policies, sensitivity labels, and DLP fundamentals.
* Ability to support compliance\-related tickets with proper governance and audit\-ready communication.


 Server \& Networking (Basic Required)
   

  

* Basic Windows Server administration knowledge (services, event logs, IIS concepts, scheduled tasks).
* Basic networking concepts: DNS, IP, proxy, firewall basics, SSL/certificates fundamentals for troubleshooting.


 Communication \& Support Skills (Mandatory)
   

  

* Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to provide clear updates to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience handling escalations, customer communications, and providing timely resolutions with professionalism.
* Strong documentation skills and ability to produce structured incident updates and RCA reports.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have**
* PowerShell scripting exposure (SharePoint Online Management Shell, PnP PowerShell).
* Understanding of Microsoft Graph basics for integration and automation.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident/Problem/Change Management).
* Experience supporting migrations (SharePoint/OneDrive) or governance initiatives.


**Shift \& Availability Requirements**
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts across any time zone (AMER/EMEA/APAC).
* On\-call support participation as per business needs.
* Ability to provide timely support during critical incidents and planned maintenance windows.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong ownership and accountability in incident handling.
* Structured problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global support model.
* Customer\-first mindset with focus on operational excellence.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent SLA adherence and reduced repeat incidents through strong troubleshooting and preventative actions.
* High customer satisfaction through clear communication and reliable resolution.
* Strong governance alignment, documentation quality, and audit\-friendly operations.


**Must Have**
* Proven SharePoint support experience, workflow troubleshooting capability, and willingness to work across time zones.


 IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. title: Presales Manager (Retail)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on
 **Presales Manager (Retail)** 
 to front\-end the organization's Presales function across service lines, business units and customer segments. The role requires a strong IT Services background, end\-to\-end presales ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership teams to convert business opportunities into compelling, solution\-led proposals. The ideal candidate should bring strong Retail domain understanding and should be comfortable engaging with global enterprise customers, leading discovery discussions, shaping solution narratives, preparing proposals, coordinating estimates and presenting to senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Presales Ownership: Own the complete presales lifecycle from opportunity qualification to proposal submission and deal closure support.
* Partner with Sales teams to understand customer requirements, business objectives, pain points, and transformation priorities.
* Lead discovery sessions, customer workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations.
* Prepare compelling proposals, solution documents, RFI/RFP/RFQ responses, capability decks and executive presentations.
* Develop win themes, differentiators, solution positioning and value propositions aligned to customer priorities.
* Drive internal pursuit reviews and ensure alignment across Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership stakeholders.
* Solution Development and Consulting: Translate customer business problems into technology\-led solutions and engagement models.
* Work with technical SMEs, architects and delivery teams to define solution approach, delivery methodology and implementation roadmap.
* Create solution narratives that clearly articulate business value, delivery approach, risks, assumptions and expected outcomes.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, commercially viable, deliverable, and aligned with organizational capabilities.
* Support proactive proposal development and strategic account planning initiatives.
* Estimation, Pricing and Commercial Support: Coordinate effort estimation activities with Delivery, Engineering, QA, Data, Cloud, UX and other relevant teams.
* Support preparation of commercial models for Fixed Price, Time and Material, Managed Services, Dedicated Team and Outcome\-based engagements.
* Capture assumptions, dependencies, risk factors, staffing models and delivery milestones for proposal submissions.
* Support commercial discussions by providing inputs on scope, effort, delivery approach and solution value.
* Retail Domain Contribution: Apply Retail domain knowledge to create business\-relevant solutions for enterprise customers.
* Support opportunities across omnichannel retail, digital commerce, store operations, merchandising, customer experience, loyalty, inventory, fulfilment, supply chain, data analytics and AI\-led transformation.
* Understand how retail business processes connect with technology platforms, operating models and transformation programs.
* Contribute domain insights during customer conversations, solutioning workshops and proposal development.
* Presales Enablement Across the Organization: Act as the front\-end owner for presales activities across the organization, supporting multiple teams and opportunity types.
* Develop reusable presales assets, templates, case studies, capability presentations, solution frameworks and proposal libraries.
* Improve presales processes, governance, pursuit quality, proposal consistency and response timelines.
* Enable Sales and Delivery teams with sharper messaging, stronger positioning and customer\-ready collateral.


**Required Experience**
* Around 10 years of hands\-on presales experience in an IT Services environment.
* BE/BTech \+ MBA from a premium institute.
* Strong end\-to\-end presales exposure including opportunity qualification, requirement understanding, solutioning, proposal development, estimation coordination, pricing support and customer presentation.
* Must have worked in core IT Services organizations with exposure to enterprise customers and multi\-stakeholder pursuits.
* Strong Retail domain experience is mandatory.
* Experience supporting global customers across regions such as North America, Europe, Middle East or APAC is preferred.
* Experience working on medium to large\-sized deals, strategic pursuits and transformation\-led proposals is preferred.
* Core Skills and Expected Capability: Presales RFI/RFP/RFQ management, bid management, proposal writing, solution documentation, win themes, and value proposition development.
* Solutioning ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions, delivery approaches, roadmaps, and commercial models.
* Retail domain expertise with strong understanding of retail operations, digital commerce, omnichannel, store systems, merchandising, loyalty, inventory, supply chain and customer experience.
* Commercial Acumen: Exposure to estimation, pricing, assumptions, dependencies, effort models and deal structuring.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling, executive presentations, and customer\-facing confidence.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to work with Sales, Delivery, Technology, Leadership and customer stakeholders in a matrix environment.

title: Academic Counsellor | Work From Office
description:
We are hiring Academic counsellors.
 



 Location: Cochin
 



 Work Mode: Work from Office \| Part time
 



  





 Teacher Training Institute of India, TTII, is expanding its admissions team and looking for ambitious sales professionals who want to build a career in the EdTech sector.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 As an Academic counsellor, you will be responsible for managing enquiries, counseling prospective students, and converting qualified leads into enrollments. This role requires strong follow up discipline, communication skills, and a target driven mindset.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Manage inbound enquiries and conduct structured follow ups
 



 • Counsel prospective students on teacher training diploma programs
 



 • Convert qualified leads into admissions
 



 • Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets
 



 • Maintain accurate CRM updates and follow up schedules
 



 • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth enrollment process
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • Graduate in any discipline
 



 • Minimum 1 year of experience in sales or business development preferred
 



 • Strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills
 



 • Target oriented and disciplined in follow ups
 



 • Experience in EdTech, inside sales, or B2B sales is an advantage
 



 • Freshers with strong sales intent and learning mindset may also apply
 



  





 What We Offer
 



 • Competitive fixed salary with performance incentives
 



 • Structured training and professional development
 



 • Clear growth pathway within the organization
 



 • Opportunity to build a long term career in the EdTech industry
 



  





 Industry: Education / EdTech
 



  




* Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn or send a direct message for further details.

title: SAP SD Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Overview**
 Build SAP ERP technology solutions to support the Sales \& Service functions such as (Order to Cash, Sales \& Distribution, PS, MM, AR, FICO, Reporting, Master Data management etc.).
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Work with the project team, team leaders, project delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create SD (OTC) solutions powered by SAP Tools.
* Collaborate with team members across different time zones to implement regulatory solutions like e\-Invoicing across different countries like France, Spain, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, etc.
* Support bank integration for AR \& AP modules.
* Acs as SME expert to translate project requirements including features, user stories and acceptance test criteria.
* Utilizes domain knowledge to be able to effectively synthesize input from multiple stakeholders to maximize delivered value.


 Day to Day: The day to day can vary in this role, but some of the more important responsibilities and tasks to undertake can be the following, however it won’t be limited to only these:
   

  

 Sprint planning: Participate in sprint planning meetings and help define what the main priorities should be for the team in the short/medium/long term. Backlog management: Prioritize and manage SAP team backlog, ensuring that it is up to date with major user stories, bug fixes and other necessary items. This will involve refining and clarifying requirements for the development team. Stakeholder communication: Regular communication with stakeholders to gather requirements, receive feedback and communicate updates as appropriate.
   

  

 Experience \- 4 to 6 Years
   

  

**Skill And Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Strong technical background, outstanding communication, presentation, time management and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage stakeholder relationships effectively, internally, and externally, and communicate to diverse stakeholders.
* Experience as SAP Consultant with at least 5 end\-to\-end SAP implementation projects.
* Proficient in all aspects of SD, including the definition and assignment of Enterprise Structure, management of Master data, Sales Order processing, and potentially integration with external systems such as SFDC, Coupa, Concur, Ariba, Mulesoft, etc.
* Sales Documents: Sales Document Header, Sales Document Item, Sales Documents, Contracts.
* Pricing: Condition table, Condition type, Access sequence, Pricing procedure, and Condition record.
* Order Management: Creation of Sales documents \- Inquiry, Quotation, Sales order (standard order, rush order, cash sales, service order, returns), Deliveries (outbound \& inbound), Billing, Invoicing, Credit memo, Debit memo; Configuration and implementation of SAP LE process, covering the complete range of functionalities like master data uploads.
* Offer expertise and comprehension of SAP Order to Cash, FICO and Purchasing principles, as well as process flows, with the ability to grasp current configurations and suggest solutions for new requirements.
